nav.external: Opens in the browser or Telegram

state.offHint: Click to turn the VPN on
state.noInternetHint: The VPN is on and will work by itself once the network is back
state.downHint: The internet works but the server is silent. Try another server

mode.label: Connection mode
mode.proxyHint: Browsers and programs that use the system proxy go through VPN. Calls on websites (WebRTC) may show your real IP to the other side - if that matters, choose "Whole computer".
mode.tunHint: All traffic of the computer goes through the VPN, including games and messengers.
mode.tunServiceHint: This mode needs the OrigamiVPN service; you will be offered to install it when connecting.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.empty: Add the subscription link from your account or the bot.

server.title: Server
server.hint: For blocked sites. Services may have a country of their own

service.missing: The OrigamiVPN service is not installed. The VPN cannot start without it: it routes all of the computer's traffic through the protected connection.

autostart.title: Start the VPN with your computer?
autostart.hint: Otherwise the VPN will not come back after a reboot. You can change this in the settings.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.lead: Add your OrigamiVPN subscription to connect.
welcome.login: Sign in with Telegram or email
welcome.loginHint: Your account page opens. After you sign in, the subscription is added to the app automatically.
welcome.fromClipboard: Found a link in the clipboard
welcome.invalidLink: This does not look like a subscription link

reminder.title: OrigamiVPN subscription
reminder.soon: Your subscription ends in {{days}}. Renew it in your account so the VPN keeps working.
reminder.lastDay: Your subscription ends today or tomorrow. Renew it in your account so the VPN keeps working.
reminder.expired: Your subscription has ended. Renew it in your account to get the VPN back.

errors.notFound: Subscription not found. Check the link or get a new one in your account.
errors.forbidden: The server refused the subscription. It may have ended or the device is blocked; contact support.
errors.tooMany: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
errors.server: The subscription server is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.badFormat: The server returned the subscription in an unsupported format. Update the app or contact support.
errors.network: No connection to the subscription server. Check your internet and try again.

check.title: Connection check
check.idle: Check whether Telegram, YouTube, Instagram and ChatGPT open
check.connectFirst: Connect and the check runs by itself
check.exit: Regular sites go through: {{country}}. YouTube and other services may have a country of their own
check.tryOther: Try another server. If that does not help, send the diagnostics to support.
check.noInternetHint: Check your Wi-Fi or cable. When the network is back, I will check again by myself.
check.copiedText: Open the support chat and paste it as a message (Ctrl+V). It holds neither your subscription link nor your full IP.

service.title: OrigamiVPN service
service.hint: Needed to send all of the computer's traffic through the VPN

autoLaunch.title: Start with the computer
autoLaunch.hint: OrigamiVPN opens on its own when the computer starts

silentStart.title: Start minimized
silentStart.hint: Straight to the tray, no window

updates.autoHint: Downloads in the background, installs on the next start
updates.byManager: Installed with {{manager}}. Download a new version from the releases page and install it: sudo pacman -U <file>
updates.newPackage: Version {{version}} is out. Download the Arch package (.pkg.tar.zst) from the releases page

help.diagnosticsHint: Copies a diagnostics report and opens the support chat

expert.title: Expert mode
expert.hint: Shows the connection mode, rules, logs, connections and all Mihomo core settings

titlebar.title: System window frame
titlebar.hint: The standard Windows title bar instead of the OrigamiVPN one

connection.title: Connection mode
connection.hint: TUN and system proxy, with their fine settings

core.title: Core and network
core.hint: DNS, ports, IPv6, LAN access, the Mihomo core and GeoIP data

service.title: Files and maintenance
service.hint: Backups, config and log folders, lite mode

servers.title: Servers
servers.lead: Each service can use its own country, all at the same time.
servers.leadExample: For example, YouTube through Finland and AI through the USA.
servers.autoNow: now {{server}}, switches by itself if a server goes down
servers.autoHint: picks the fastest server by itself
servers.tipAuto: Not sure what to pick? Keep «Auto».
servers.tipVariant: Not loading? Try another connection variant of the same country.
servers.variantHelp: Choosing a country takes its fastest variant. While automatic switching is on, the app moves to another variant when this one stops answering or becomes clearly slower. Click a variant to keep it. Hysteria2 is for games and calls.

blocks.mainHint: Powerful servers for every day: sites, video, messengers
blocks.extraHint: For AI, work, other countries and special tasks

servers.foot: A site or game not working? Pick another server for this service,
servers.chosen: {{service}}: {{server}}. Other services stay as they were
servers.autoVariant: Switch to the fastest variant automatically
servers.autoVariantSwitched: {{service}}: switched to {{server}}, it is faster now
servers.noAddressHint: The IP address of this server could not be found: DNS is broken at your provider or in the subscription. The server itself may be fine. Try another server or refresh the subscription.
servers.checkedNoAddress: Checked. Address not found: {{names}}. This is a DNS problem, not the server.{{dead}}
servers.checkedNoInternet: No server answered: it looks like there is no internet
servers.checkedNoneAnswer: No server answered although the internet works. Contact support

report.open: A site or game not working?
report.title: A site or game is not working
report.commentPlaceholder: For example, cannot join a match

recordHint.app: Press «Start», then open the game or app and try what does not work. After a minute press «Done».
recordHint.site: Press «Start», then open the site in your browser and reload the page. After a minute press «Done».

report.nothing: Nothing was recorded. Try again: press «Start» first, then open the game or site.
report.sends: names of the ticked programs, the addresses they reached and which server was used.
report.keeps: other programs, browser history, your files.

errors.noSubscription: No OrigamiVPN subscription found. Add one and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many reports in a row. Try again in an hour.

report.sent: Thank you! I will look and add it to the rules. When it is added, I will message you in the bot; the update arrives by itself.

notices.profileKept: The subscription from the server came broken, so the previous one stays and the VPN keeps working. It will be updated later.

coreTrouble.title: The VPN does not start
coreTrouble.serviceCoreStopped: The VPN core stopped and did not restart on its own. A restart usually helps.
coreTrouble.startFailed: The VPN core could not start. A restart usually helps; if not, reinstall the service.
coreTrouble.config: The subscription settings did not pass the check. Update the subscription: that is usually enough.
coreTrouble.stillBroken: Did not help? Copy the diagnostics and send them to support.
coreTrouble.restarted: The VPN stopped and restarted on its own

recovery.restarted: The network changed or the computer woke up: the VPN reconnected
recovery.restartedStartup: VPN did not answer after start: reconnected it
recovery.restartedHang: VPN stopped passing traffic: reconnected it

subscription.autoHint: New servers and countries show up on their own.
subscription.phoneHint: Scan the QR code in Happ or another app. It opens on a click.

routes.empty: Nothing here yet. Add a game, program or site: while a rule is here, it wins over ours. Remove it, and everything goes by our rules again.
routes.badApp: Enter a program, for example steam.exe
routes.badSite: Enter a site address, for example example.com
routes.proxyMode: VPN runs as a system proxy now: many games and programs ignore it, so a rule for them will not work. Turn on full mode (TUN).
routes.serverHint: Where the programs and sites you sent through VPN go.

programs.title: Programs
programs.lead: Which programs use the internet and how they go: through VPN or direct. You can choose the way for each.
programs.period: Traffic is approximate, counted since the app started and while VPN is on.
programs.empty: Nothing yet. Programs appear here as soon as they use the internet.
programs.off: VPN is off. Turn it on and programs will appear here.
programs.foot: Program not listed, or want a rule for a site?

trayHint.title: The VPN keeps working
trayHint.text: The window closes and the app stays in the tray by the clock; the icon may hide under the ^ arrow. To quit completely, right-click the icon.
